title: When you don't hear back from job applications...
description:
Applying to a multitude of jobs without a single interview can be some of the lowest times in job search. So what do you do to turn things back in your favor. If you’ve sent out that many resumes and haven’t heard back from anyone it’s time to look at your resume and adjust accordingly. #jobsearch #resumetips #resume
